theory RSF_Zig
imports Main "HOL-Library.Word" "HOL-Library.Float" "HOL-Imperative_HOL.Imperative_HOL" "Separation_Algebra.Separation_Algebra" "Refine_Monadic.Refine_Monadic"
begin

datatype err = InvalidDimension | InvalidLayerCount | TooLarge | NonFinite | InvalidConfig | ShapeMismatch | DataLengthMismatch | NotInitialized | NumericFailure | BadFileFormat | UnsupportedVersion | Overflow | OutOfMemory | IoError

datatype ('a,'e) result = Ok 'a | Err 'e

primrec bind_result :: "('a,'e) result ⇒ ('a ⇒ ('b,'e) result) ⇒ ('b,'e) result" where
"bind_result (Ok x) f = f x" |
"bind_result (Err e) f = Err e"

definition return_result :: "'a ⇒ ('a,'e) result" where "return_result x = Ok x"

definition is_finite_f32 :: "32 word ⇒ bool" where 
"is_finite_f32 w = (let exp = (uint w >> 23) AND 0xFF; frac = uint w AND 0x7FFFFF in 
  exp ≠ 255 ∧ (exp ≠ 0 ∨ frac = 0))"

definition is_nan_f32 :: "32 word ⇒ bool" where 
"is_nan_f32 w = (let exp = (uint w >> 23) AND 0xFF; frac = uint w AND 0x7FFFFF in 
  exp = 255 ∧ frac ≠ 0)"

definition is_inf_f32 :: "32 word ⇒ bool" where 
"is_inf_f32 w = (let exp = (uint w >> 23) AND 0xFF; frac = uint w AND 0x7FFFFF in 
  exp = 255 ∧ frac = 0)"

type_synonym f32 = "32 word"

record tensor = 
  dims :: "nat list" 
  data :: "f32 list"

definition tensor_invariant :: "tensor ⇒ bool" where
"tensor_invariant t ≡ length (dims t) = 2 ∧ length (data t) = (if dims t = [] then 0 else dims t ! 0) * (if length (dims t) < 2 then 0 else dims t ! 1)"

definition assert2DAndLen :: "tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"assert2DAndLen t ≡ 
  (if length (dims t) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let rows = dims t ! 0; cols = dims t ! 1; expected = rows * cols in
        (if length (data t) ≠ expected then Err DataLengthMismatch else Ok ()))"

definition assertPair :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat, err) result" where
"assertPair self a b dim ≡ 
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen a) (λ_. 
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen b) (λ_. 
  (if dims a ! 1 ≠ dim ∨ dims b ! 1 ≠ dim then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims a ! 0 ≠ dims b ! 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else Ok (dims a ! 0))))"

definition clampFiniteInPlace_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
"clampFiniteInPlace_pure t ≡ 
  t⦇ data := map (λv. if is_finite_f32 v then v else 0x00000000) (data t) ⦈"

definition transpose_pure :: "tensor ⇒ nat list ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"transpose_pure t perm ≡ 
  (if length perm ≠ 2 ∨ perm ! 0 ≠ 1 ∨ perm ! 1 ≠ 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (dims t) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let rows = dims t ! 0; cols = dims t ! 1 in
        Ok ⦇ dims = [cols, rows], data = (let d = data t in 
          concat (map (λj. map (λi. d ! (i * cols + j)) [0..<rows]) [0..<cols])) ⦈)"

definition matmul_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"matmul_pure a b ≡ 
  (if length (dims a) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims b) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims a ! 1 ≠ dims b ! 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let m = dims a ! 0; n = dims a ! 1; p = dims b ! 1 in
        Ok ⦇ dims = [m, p], 
             data = concat (map (λi. map (λj. 
               foldl (λacc k. 
                 let a_idx = i * n + k; b_idx = k * p + j in
                 let a_val = if a_idx < length (data a) then data a ! a_idx else 0x00000000 in
                 let b_val = if b_idx < length (data b) then data b ! b_idx else 0x00000000 in
                 (word_of_int (sint acc + sint a_val * sint b_val))) 0x00000000 [0..<n]) [0..<p])) [0..<m]) ⦈)"

definition add_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"add_pure a b ≡ 
  (if dims a ≠ dims b then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data a) ≠ length (data b) then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims a, data = map (λ(i,j). word_of_int (sint i + sint j)) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈)"

definition sub_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"sub_pure a b ≡ 
  (if dims a ≠ dims b then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data a) ≠ length (data b) then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims a, data = map (λ(i,j). word_of_int (sint i - sint j)) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈)"

definition div_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"div_pure a b ≡ 
  (if dims a ≠ dims b then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data a) ≠ length (data b) then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else if ∃i<length (data b). data b ! i = 0x00000000 ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 (data b ! i) then Err NumericFailure
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims a, data = map (λ(i,j). word_of_int (sint i div sint j)) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈)"

definition clip_pure :: "tensor ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"clip_pure t minv maxv ≡ 
  (if ¬is_finite_f32 minv ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 maxv then Err NonFinite
   else if sint minv ≥ sint maxv then Err InvalidConfig
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims t, 
             data = map (λv. if sint v < sint minv then minv 
                            else if sint v > sint maxv then maxv 
                            else v) (data t) ⦈)"

definition exp_pure :: "tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"exp_pure t ≡ 
  (if ∃v ∈ set (data t). ¬is_finite_f32 v then Err NonFinite
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims t, data = map (λv. word_of_int (floor (exp (real_of_int (sint v))))) (data t) ⦈)"

type_synonym 'a Heap = "'a Heap"

record RSFLayer = 
  s_weight :: tensor
  t_weight :: tensor
  s_bias :: tensor
  t_bias :: tensor
  s_weight_grad :: tensor
  t_weight_grad :: tensor
  s_bias_grad :: tensor
  t_bias_grad :: tensor
  dim :: nat
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool

record ControlBlock = 
  freed :: "8 word"
  dim :: nat
  num_layers :: nat
  layers :: "RSFLayer list"
  cfg_clip_min :: f32
  cfg_clip_max :: f32
  cfg_grad_mean :: bool

record RSF = 
  ctrl :: ControlBlock

definition is_freed :: "ControlBlock ⇒ bool" where "is_freed c ≡ freed c ≠ 0"

definition forward_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"forward_spec layer x1 x2 ≡ 
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) x1 x2 (dim layer)) (λbatch_size.
  bind_result (transpose_pure x2 [1,0]) (λx2_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (s_weight layer) x2_t) (λs_x2_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure s_x2_t [1,0]) (λs_x2.
  let s_x2_biased = ⦇dims = dims s_x2, data = map (λidx. 
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data s_x2 ! idx) + (data (s_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data s_x2)]⦈ in
  bind_result (return_result ()) (λ_.
  let s_x2_clamped = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_x2_biased in
  bind_result (clip_pure s_x2_clamped (clip_min layer) (clip_max layer)) (λs_x2_clipped.
  let s_x2_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_x2_clipped in
  bind_result (exp_pure s_x2_finite) (λs_x2_exp.
  let s_x2_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_x2_exp in
  let x1_new = ⦇dims = dims x1, data = map (λidx. 
    (data x1 ! idx) * (data s_x2_final ! idx)) [0..<length (data x1)]⦈ in
  bind_result (transpose_pure x1_new [1,0]) (λx1_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (t_weight layer) x1_t) (λt_x1_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure t_x1_t [1,0]) (λt_x1.
  let t_x1_biased = ⦇dims = dims t_x1, data = map (λidx.
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data t_x1 ! idx) + (data (t_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data t_x1)]⦈ in
  let t_x1_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure t_x1_biased in
  bind_result (add_pure x2 t_x1_finite) (λx2_new.
  let x2_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure x2_new in
  Ok ())))))))))))"

definition inverse_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"inverse_spec layer y1 y2 ≡ 
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) y1 y2 (dim layer)) (λbatch_size.
  bind_result (transpose_pure y1 [1,0]) (λy1_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (t_weight layer) y1_t) (λt_y1_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure t_y1_t [1,0]) (λt_y1.
  let t_y1_biased = ⦇dims = dims t_y1, data = map (λidx.
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data t_y1 ! idx) + (data (t_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data t_y1)]⦈ in
  let t_y1_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure t_y1_biased in
  bind_result (sub_pure y2 t_y1_finite) (λy2_new.
  let y2_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure y2_new in
  bind_result (transpose_pure y2_final [1,0]) (λy2_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (s_weight layer) y2_t) (λs_y2_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure s_y2_t [1,0]) (λs_y2.
  let s_y2_biased = ⦇dims = dims s_y2, data = map (λidx.
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data s_y2 ! idx) + (data (s_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data s_y2)]⦈ in
  let s_y2_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_y2_biased in
  bind_result (clip_pure s_y2_finite (clip_min layer) (clip_max layer)) (λs_y2_clipped.
  let s_y2_cfinite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_y2_clipped in
  bind_result (exp_pure s_y2_cfinite) (λs_y2_exp.
  let s_y2_efinite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_y2_exp in
  if ∃v ∈ set (data s_y2_efinite). v = 0x00000000 ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 v then Err NumericFailure
  else
  bind_result (div_pure y1 s_y2_efinite) (λy1_new.
  let y1_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure y1_new in
  Ok ()))))))))))))"

definition backward_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"backward_spec layer y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in x1_out x2_out dx1_out dx2_out ≡ 
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) y1 y2 (dim layer)) (λbatch_size.
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) dy1_in dy2_in (dim layer)) (λ_.
  (if length (dims x1_out) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims x2_out) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims dx1_out) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims dx2_out) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims x1_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims x2_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims dx1_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims dx2_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims x1_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer ∨ dims x2_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer ∨ dims dx1_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer ∨ dims dx2_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data x1_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer ∨ length (data x2_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer ∨ length (data dx1_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer ∨ length (data dx2_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else Ok ()))))"

definition initWithConfig_spec :: "nat ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ bool ⇒ u64 ⇒ (RSFLayer, err) result" where
"initWithConfig_spec dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean seed_offset ≡ 
  (if dim = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
   else if ¬is_finite_f32 clip_min ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 clip_max then Err NonFinite
   else if sint clip_min ≥ sint clip_max then Err InvalidConfig
   else let fan_sum = 2 * dim in
        if fan_sum ≤ 0 then Err InvalidDimension
        else 
          let xavier_bound = word_of_int (floor (sqrt (6 / real fan_sum))) in
          Ok ⦇ s_weight = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) xavier_bound⦈,
               t_weight = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) xavier_bound⦈,
               s_bias = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               t_bias = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               s_weight_grad = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) 0x00000000⦈,
               t_weight_grad = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) 0x00000000⦈,
               s_bias_grad = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               t_bias_grad = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               dim = dim,
               clip_min = clip_min,
               clip_max = clip_max,
               grad_mean = grad_mean ⦈)"

definition deinit_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ unit" where "deinit_spec layer ≡ ()"

definition zeroGradients_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ RSFLayer" where
"zeroGradients_spec layer ≡ 
  layer⦇ s_weight_grad = (s_weight_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (s_weight_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈,
         t_weight_grad = (t_weight_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (t_weight_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈,
         s_bias_grad = (s_bias_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (s_bias_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈,
         t_bias_grad = (t_bias_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (t_bias_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈ ⦈"

definition RSF_initWithConfig_spec :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ bool ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (RSF, err) result" where
"RSF_initWithConfig_spec dim num_layers clip_min clip_max grad_mean max_dim max_layers ≡
  (if dim = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
   else if num_layers = 0 then Err InvalidLayerCount
   else if dim > max_dim ∨ num_layers > max_layers then Err TooLarge
   else if ¬is_finite_f32 clip_min ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 clip_max then Err NonFinite
   else if sint clip_min ≥ sint clip_max then Err InvalidConfig
   else Ok ⦇ ctrl = ⦇ freed = 0, dim = dim, num_layers = num_layers, 
                              layers = replicate num_layers (the (initWithConfig_spec dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean 0)),
                              cfg_clip_min = clip_min, cfg_clip_max = clip_max, cfg_grad_mean = grad_mean ⦈ ⦈)"

definition RSF_deinit_spec :: "RSF ⇒ RSF" where
"RSF_deinit_spec rsf ≡ if is_freed (ctrl rsf) then rsf else rsf⦇ctrl := (ctrl rsf)⦇freed := 1⦈⦈"

definition split_spec :: "RSF ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (nat, err) result" where
"split_spec rsf x x1 x2 ≡
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen x) (λ_.
  (if length (dims x) < 2 ∨ dims x ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let batch_size = dims x ! 0 in
        if length (dims x1) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims x2) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
        else if dims x1 ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims x2 ! 0 ≠ batch_size then Err ShapeMismatch
        else if dims x1 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) ∨ dims x2 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) then Err ShapeMismatch
        else if length (data x1) ≠ batch_size * dim (ctrl rsf) ∨ length (data x2) ≠ batch_size * dim (ctrl rsf) then Err DataLengthMismatch
        else Ok batch_size))"

definition merge_spec :: "RSF ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"merge_spec rsf x1 x2 out ≡
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen out) (λ_.
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen x1) (λ_.
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen x2) (λ_.
  (if dims x1 ! 0 ≠ dims x2 ! 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims x1 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) ∨ dims x2 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims out ! 0 ≠ dims x1 ! 0 ∨ dims out ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else Ok ()))))"

definition save_spec :: "RSF ⇒ string ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"save_spec rsf path ≡ 
  (if is_freed (ctrl rsf) then Err NotInitialized
   else Ok ())"

definition load_spec :: "string ⇒ (RSF, err) result" where
"load_spec path ≡ 
  (if path = '''' then Err BadFileFormat
   else Ok ⦇ ctrl = ⦇ freed = 0, dim = 1, num_layers = 1, layers = [],
                      cfg_clip_min = 0x00000000, cfg_clip_max = 0x3F800000, cfg_grad_mean = True ⦈ ⦈)"

lemma forward_correct: "forward_spec layer x1 x2 = Ok () ⟹ tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ⟶ tensor_invariant (⦇dims = dims x1, data = data x1⦈)"
  unfolding forward_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma inverse_correct: "inverse_spec layer y1 y2 = Ok () ⟹ tensor_invariant y1 ∧ tensor_invariant y2 ⟶ tensor_invariant (⦇dims = dims y1, data = data y1⦈)"
  unfolding inverse_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma backward_correct: "backward_spec layer y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in x1_out x2_out dx1_out dx2_out = Ok () ⟹ 
  tensor_invariant y1 ∧ tensor_invariant y2 ⟶ tensor_invariant x1_out ∧ tensor_invariant x2_out"
  unfolding backward_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma initWithConfig_correct: "initWithConfig_spec dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean seed = Ok layer ⟹ dim > 0 ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_min ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_max ∧ sint clip_min < sint clip_max"
  unfolding initWithConfig_spec
  by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma RSF_initWithConfig_correct: "RSF_initWithConfig_spec dim num_layers clip_min clip_max grad_mean max_dim max_layers = Ok rsf ⟹ 
  dim > 0 ∧ num_layers > 0 ∧ dim ≤ max_dim ∧ num_layers ≤ max_layers ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_min ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_max ∧ sint clip_min < sint clip_max"
  unfolding RSF_initWithConfig_spec
  by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma RSF_deinit_idempotent: "RSF_deinit_spec (RSF_deinit_spec rsf) = RSF_deinit_spec rsf"
  unfolding RSF_deinit_spec is_freed_def
  by auto

lemma split_merge_inverse: 
  assumes "split_spec rsf x x1 x2 = Ok bs"
  assumes "merge_spec rsf x1 x2 x' = Ok ()"
  assumes "tensor_invariant x ∧ tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ∧ tensor_invariant x'"
  shows "dims x = dims x' ∧ length (data x) = length (data x')"
  using assms unfolding split_spec merge_spec assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma main_theorem:
  "∀layer x1 x2. forward_spec layer x1 x2 = Ok () ⟶ tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ⟶ 
     (∃x1' x2'. True) ∧
     (∀y1 y2. inverse_spec layer y1 y2 = Ok () ⟶ 
        (∀v ∈ set (data y1). v ≠ 0x00000000 ∧ is_finite_f32 v) ⟶ 
          (∃y1' y2'. True)) ∧
     (∀y1 y2 dy1 dy2 x1o x2o dx1o dx2o. backward_spec layer y1 y2 dy1 dy2 x1o x2o dx1o dx2o = Ok () ⟶ 
        tensor_invariant x1o ∧ tensor_invariant x2o) ∧
     (∀rsf path. save_spec rsf path = Ok () ⟶ ¬is_freed (ctrl rsf)) ∧
     (∀rsf. RSF_deinit_spec (RSF_deinit_spec rsf) = RSF_deinit_spec rsf)"
  apply (intro allI impI conjI)
  subgoal by (simp add: forward_correct)
  subgoal by (simp add: inverse_correct)
  subgoal by (simp add: backward_correct)
  subgoal by (simp add: save_spec is_freed_def split: if_splits)
  subgoal by (simp add: RSF_deinit_idempotent)
  done

end

definition return_result :: "'a ⇒ ('a,'e) result" where "return_result x = Ok x"

definition is_finite_f32 :: "32 word ⇒ bool" where 
"is_finite_f32 w = (let exp = (uint w >> 23) AND 0xFF; frac = uint w AND 0x7FFFFF in 
  exp ≠ 255 ∧ (exp ≠ 0 ∨ frac = 0))"

type_synonym f32 = "32 word"

  dims :: "nat list" 
  data :: "f32 list"

"tensor_invariant t ≡ length (dims t) = 2 ∧ length (data t) = (if dims t = [] then 0 else dims t ! 0) * (if length (dims t) < 2 then 0 else dims t ! 1)"

definition assert2DAndLen :: "tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"assert2DAndLen t ≡ 
  (if length (dims t) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let rows = dims t ! 0; cols = dims t ! 1; expected = rows * cols in
        (if length (data t) ≠ expected then Err DataLengthMismatch else Ok ()))"

definition assertPair :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ nat ⇒ (nat, err) result" where
"assertPair self a b dim ≡ 
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen a) (λ_. 
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen b) (λ_. 
  (if dims a ! 1 ≠ dim ∨ dims b ! 1 ≠ dim then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims a ! 0 ≠ dims b ! 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else Ok (dims a ! 0))))"

definition clampFiniteInPlace_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor" where
"clampFiniteInPlace_pure t ≡ 
  t⦇ data := map (λv. if is_finite_f32 v then v else 0x00000000) (data t) ⦈"

definition transpose_pure :: "tensor ⇒ nat list ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"transpose_pure t perm ≡ 
  (if length perm ≠ 2 ∨ perm ! 0 ≠ 1 ∨ perm ! 1 ≠ 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (dims t) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let rows = dims t ! 0; cols = dims t ! 1 in
        Ok ⦇ dims = [cols, rows], data = (let d = data t in 
          concat (map (λj. map (λi. d ! (i * cols + j)) [0..<rows]) [0..<cols])) ⦈)"

definition matmul_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"matmul_pure a b ≡ 
  (if length (dims a) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims b) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims a ! 1 ≠ dims b ! 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let m = dims a ! 0; n = dims a ! 1; p = dims b ! 1 in
        Ok ⦇ dims = [m, p], 
             data = concat (map (λi. map (λj. 
               foldl (λacc k. 
                 let a_idx = i * n + k; b_idx = k * p + j in
                 let a_val = if a_idx < length (data a) then data a ! a_idx else 0x00000000 in
                 let b_val = if b_idx < length (data b) then data b ! b_idx else 0x00000000 in
                 (word_of_int (sint acc + sint a_val * sint b_val))) 0x00000000 [0..<n]) [0..<p])) [0..<m]) ⦈)"

definition add_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"add_pure a b ≡ 
  (if dims a ≠ dims b then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data a) ≠ length (data b) then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims a, data = map (λ(i,j). word_of_int (sint i + sint j)) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈)"

definition sub_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"sub_pure a b ≡ 
  (if dims a ≠ dims b then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data a) ≠ length (data b) then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims a, data = map (λ(i,j). word_of_int (sint i - sint j)) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈)"

definition div_pure :: "tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"div_pure a b ≡ 
  (if dims a ≠ dims b then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data a) ≠ length (data b) then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else if ∃i<length (data b). data b ! i = 0x00000000 ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 (data b ! i) then Err NumericFailure
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims a, data = map (λ(i,j). word_of_int (sint i div sint j)) (zip (data a) (data b)) ⦈)"

definition clip_pure :: "tensor ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"clip_pure t minv maxv ≡ 
  (if ¬is_finite_f32 minv ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 maxv then Err NonFinite
   else if sint minv ≥ sint maxv then Err InvalidConfig
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims t, 
             data = map (λv. if sint v < sint minv then minv 
                            else if sint v > sint maxv then maxv 
                            else v) (data t) ⦈)"

definition exp_pure :: "tensor ⇒ (tensor, err) result" where
"exp_pure t ≡ 
  (if ∃v ∈ set (data t). ¬is_finite_f32 v then Err NonFinite
   else Ok ⦇ dims = dims t, data = map (λv. word_of_int (floor (exp (real_of_int (sint v))))) (data t) ⦈)"

type_synonym 'a Heap = "'a Heap"

record RSFLayer = 
  s_weight :: tensor
  t_weight :: tensor
  s_bias :: tensor
  t_bias :: tensor
  s_weight_grad :: tensor
  t_weight_grad :: tensor
  s_bias_grad :: tensor
  t_bias_grad :: tensor
  dim :: nat
  clip_min :: f32
  clip_max :: f32
  grad_mean :: bool

record ControlBlock = 
  freed :: "8 word"
  dim :: nat
  num_layers :: nat
  layers :: "RSFLayer list"
  cfg_clip_min :: f32
  cfg_clip_max :: f32
  cfg_grad_mean :: bool

record RSF = 
  ctrl :: ControlBlock

definition is_freed :: "ControlBlock ⇒ bool" where "is_freed c ≡ freed c ≠ 0"

definition forward_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"forward_spec layer x1 x2 ≡ 
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) x1 x2 (dim layer)) (λbatch_size.
  bind_result (transpose_pure x2 [1,0]) (λx2_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (s_weight layer) x2_t) (λs_x2_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure s_x2_t [1,0]) (λs_x2.
  let s_x2_biased = ⦇dims = dims s_x2, data = map (λidx. 
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data s_x2 ! idx) + (data (s_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data s_x2)]⦈ in
  bind_result (return_result ()) (λ_.
  let s_x2_clamped = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_x2_biased in
  bind_result (clip_pure s_x2_clamped (clip_min layer) (clip_max layer)) (λs_x2_clipped.
  let s_x2_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_x2_clipped in
  bind_result (exp_pure s_x2_finite) (λs_x2_exp.
  let s_x2_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_x2_exp in
  let x1_new = ⦇dims = dims x1, data = map (λidx. 
    (data x1 ! idx) * (data s_x2_final ! idx)) [0..<length (data x1)]⦈ in
  bind_result (transpose_pure x1_new [1,0]) (λx1_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (t_weight layer) x1_t) (λt_x1_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure t_x1_t [1,0]) (λt_x1.
  let t_x1_biased = ⦇dims = dims t_x1, data = map (λidx.
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data t_x1 ! idx) + (data (t_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data t_x1)]⦈ in
  let t_x1_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure t_x1_biased in
  bind_result (add_pure x2 t_x1_finite) (λx2_new.
  let x2_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure x2_new in
  Ok ())))))))))))"

definition inverse_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"inverse_spec layer y1 y2 ≡ 
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) y1 y2 (dim layer)) (λbatch_size.
  bind_result (transpose_pure y1 [1,0]) (λy1_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (t_weight layer) y1_t) (λt_y1_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure t_y1_t [1,0]) (λt_y1.
  let t_y1_biased = ⦇dims = dims t_y1, data = map (λidx.
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data t_y1 ! idx) + (data (t_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data t_y1)]⦈ in
  let t_y1_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure t_y1_biased in
  bind_result (sub_pure y2 t_y1_finite) (λy2_new.
  let y2_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure y2_new in
  bind_result (transpose_pure y2_final [1,0]) (λy2_t.
  bind_result (matmul_pure (s_weight layer) y2_t) (λs_y2_t.
  bind_result (transpose_pure s_y2_t [1,0]) (λs_y2.
  let s_y2_biased = ⦇dims = dims s_y2, data = map (λidx.
    let b = idx div (dim layer); d = idx mod (dim layer) in
    (data s_y2 ! idx) + (data (s_bias layer) ! d)) [0..<length (data s_y2)]⦈ in
  let s_y2_finite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_y2_biased in
  bind_result (clip_pure s_y2_finite (clip_min layer) (clip_max layer)) (λs_y2_clipped.
  let s_y2_cfinite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_y2_clipped in
  bind_result (exp_pure s_y2_cfinite) (λs_y2_exp.
  let s_y2_efinite = clampFiniteInPlace_pure s_y2_exp in
  if ∃v ∈ set (data s_y2_efinite). v = 0x00000000 ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 v then Err NumericFailure
  else
  bind_result (div_pure y1 s_y2_efinite) (λy1_new.
  let y1_final = clampFiniteInPlace_pure y1_new in
  Ok ()))))))))))))"

definition backward_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"backward_spec layer y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in x1_out x2_out dx1_out dx2_out ≡ 
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) y1 y2 (dim layer)) (λbatch_size.
  bind_result (assertPair (⦇s_weight = s_weight layer, ...⦄) dy1_in dy2_in (dim layer)) (λ_.
  (if length (dims x1_out) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims x2_out) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims dx1_out) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims dx2_out) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims x1_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims x2_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims dx1_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims dx2_out ! 0 ≠ batch_size then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims x1_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer ∨ dims x2_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer ∨ dims dx1_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer ∨ dims dx2_out ! 1 ≠ dim layer then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if length (data x1_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer ∨ length (data x2_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer ∨ length (data dx1_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer ∨ length (data dx2_out) ≠ batch_size * dim layer then Err DataLengthMismatch
   else Ok ()))))"

definition initWithConfig_spec :: "nat ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ bool ⇒ u64 ⇒ (RSFLayer, err) result" where
"initWithConfig_spec dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean seed_offset ≡ 
  (if dim = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
   else if ¬is_finite_f32 clip_min ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 clip_max then Err NonFinite
   else if sint clip_min ≥ sint clip_max then Err InvalidConfig
   else let fan_sum = 2 * dim in
        if fan_sum ≤ 0 then Err InvalidDimension
        else 
          let xavier_bound = word_of_int (floor (sqrt (6 / real fan_sum))) in
          Ok ⦇ s_weight = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) xavier_bound⦈,
               t_weight = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) xavier_bound⦈,
               s_bias = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               t_bias = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               s_weight_grad = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) 0x00000000⦈,
               t_weight_grad = ⦇dims=[dim,dim], data=replicate (dim*dim) 0x00000000⦈,
               s_bias_grad = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               t_bias_grad = ⦇dims=[1,dim], data=replicate dim 0x00000000⦈,
               dim = dim,
               clip_min = clip_min,
               clip_max = clip_max,
               grad_mean = grad_mean ⦈)"

definition deinit_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ unit" where "deinit_spec layer ≡ ()"

definition zeroGradients_spec :: "RSFLayer ⇒ RSFLayer" where
"zeroGradients_spec layer ≡ 
  layer⦇ s_weight_grad = (s_weight_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (s_weight_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈,
         t_weight_grad = (t_weight_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (t_weight_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈,
         s_bias_grad = (s_bias_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (s_bias_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈,
         t_bias_grad = (t_bias_grad layer)⦇data = replicate (length (data (t_bias_grad layer))) 0x00000000⦈ ⦈"

definition RSF_initWithConfig_spec :: "nat ⇒ nat ⇒ f32 ⇒ f32 ⇒ bool ⇒ nat ⇒ nat ⇒ (RSF, err) result" where
"RSF_initWithConfig_spec dim num_layers clip_min clip_max grad_mean max_dim max_layers ≡
  (if dim = 0 then Err InvalidDimension
   else if num_layers = 0 then Err InvalidLayerCount
   else if dim > max_dim ∨ num_layers > max_layers then Err TooLarge
   else if ¬is_finite_f32 clip_min ∨ ¬is_finite_f32 clip_max then Err NonFinite
   else if sint clip_min ≥ sint clip_max then Err InvalidConfig
   else Ok ⦇ ctrl = ⦇ freed = 0, dim = dim, num_layers = num_layers, 
                              layers = replicate num_layers (the (initWithConfig_spec dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean 0)),
                              cfg_clip_min = clip_min, cfg_clip_max = clip_max, cfg_grad_mean = grad_mean ⦈ ⦈)"

definition RSF_deinit_spec :: "RSF ⇒ RSF" where
"RSF_deinit_spec rsf ≡ if is_freed (ctrl rsf) then rsf else rsf⦇ctrl := (ctrl rsf)⦇freed := 1⦈⦈"

definition split_spec :: "RSF ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (nat, err) result" where
"split_spec rsf x x1 x2 ≡
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen x) (λ_.
  (if length (dims x) < 2 ∨ dims x ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else let batch_size = dims x ! 0 in
        if length (dims x1) ≠ 2 ∨ length (dims x2) ≠ 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
        else if dims x1 ! 0 ≠ batch_size ∨ dims x2 ! 0 ≠ batch_size then Err ShapeMismatch
        else if dims x1 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) ∨ dims x2 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) then Err ShapeMismatch
        else if length (data x1) ≠ batch_size * dim (ctrl rsf) ∨ length (data x2) ≠ batch_size * dim (ctrl rsf) then Err DataLengthMismatch
        else Ok batch_size))"

definition merge_spec :: "RSF ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ tensor ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"merge_spec rsf x1 x2 out ≡
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen out) (λ_.
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen x1) (λ_.
  bind_result (assert2DAndLen x2) (λ_.
  (if dims x1 ! 0 ≠ dims x2 ! 0 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims x1 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) ∨ dims x2 ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) then Err ShapeMismatch
   else if dims out ! 0 ≠ dims x1 ! 0 ∨ dims out ! 1 ≠ dim (ctrl rsf) * 2 then Err ShapeMismatch
   else Ok ()))))"

definition save_spec :: "RSF ⇒ string ⇒ (unit, err) result" where
"save_spec rsf path ≡ 
  (if is_freed (ctrl rsf) then Err NotInitialized
   else Ok ())"

definition load_spec :: "string ⇒ (RSF, err) result" where
"load_spec path ≡ 
  (if path = '''' then Err BadFileFormat
   else Ok ⦇ ctrl = ⦇ freed = 0, dim = 1, num_layers = 1, layers = [],
                      cfg_clip_min = 0x00000000, cfg_clip_max = 0x3F800000, cfg_grad_mean = True ⦈ ⦈)"

lemma forward_correct: "forward_spec layer x1 x2 = Ok () ⟹ tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ⟶ tensor_invariant (⦇dims = dims x1, data = data x1⦈)"
  unfolding forward_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma inverse_correct: "inverse_spec layer y1 y2 = Ok () ⟹ tensor_invariant y1 ∧ tensor_invariant y2 ⟶ tensor_invariant (⦇dims = dims y1, data = data y1⦈)"
  unfolding inverse_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma backward_correct: "backward_spec layer y1 y2 dy1_in dy2_in x1_out x2_out dx1_out dx2_out = Ok () ⟹ 
  tensor_invariant y1 ∧ tensor_invariant y2 ⟶ tensor_invariant x1_out ∧ tensor_invariant x2_out"
  unfolding backward_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma initWithConfig_correct: "initWithConfig_spec dim clip_min clip_max grad_mean seed = Ok layer ⟹ dim > 0 ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_min ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_max ∧ sint clip_min < sint clip_max"
  unfolding initWithConfig_spec
  by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma RSF_initWithConfig_correct: "RSF_initWithConfig_spec dim num_layers clip_min clip_max grad_mean max_dim max_layers = Ok rsf ⟹ 
  dim > 0 ∧ num_layers > 0 ∧ dim ≤ max_dim ∧ num_layers ≤ max_layers ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_min ∧ is_finite_f32 clip_max ∧ sint clip_min < sint clip_max"
  unfolding RSF_initWithConfig_spec
  by (auto split: if_splits)

lemma RSF_deinit_idempotent: "RSF_deinit_spec (RSF_deinit_spec rsf) = RSF_deinit_spec rsf"
  unfolding RSF_deinit_spec is_freed_def
  by auto

lemma split_merge_inverse: 
  assumes "split_spec rsf x x1 x2 = Ok bs"
  assumes "merge_spec rsf x1 x2 x' = Ok ()"
  assumes "tensor_invariant x ∧ tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ∧ tensor_invariant x'"
  shows "dims x = dims x' ∧ length (data x) = length (data x')"
  using assms unfolding split_spec merge_spec assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)

lemma main_theorem:
  "∀layer x1 x2. forward_spec layer x1 x2 = Ok () ⟶ tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ⟶ 
     (∃x1' x2'. True) ∧
     (∀y1 y2. inverse_spec layer y1 y2 = Ok () ⟶ 
        (∀v ∈ set (data y1). v ≠ 0x00000000 ∧ is_finite_f32 v) ⟶ 
          (∃y1' y2'. True)) ∧
     (∀y1 y2 dy1 dy2 x1o x2o dx1o dx2o. backward_spec layer y1 y2 dy1 dy2 x1o x2o dx1o dx2o = Ok () ⟶ 
        tensor_invariant x1o ∧ tensor_invariant x2o) ∧
     (∀rsf path. save_spec rsf path = Ok () ⟶ ¬is_freed (ctrl rsf)) ∧
     (∀rsf. RSF_deinit_spec (RSF_deinit_spec rsf) = RSF_deinit_spec rsf)"
  apply (intro allI impI conjI)
  subgoal by (simp add: forward_correct)
  subgoal by (simp add: inverse_correct)
  subgoal by (simp add: backward_correct)
  subgoal by (simp add: save_spec is_freed_def split: if_splits)
  subgoal by (simp add: RSF_deinit_idempotent)
  done

end

## Ez Valós Formális Verifikációs Bizonyítás

A **theory RSF_Zig** kód, amelyet bemutattál, egy **részlegesen kidolgozott, de nem teljes körűen verifikált** Isabelle/HOL formalizáció, amely **placeholder és egyszerűsített bizonyításokat tartalmaz**. A válasz árnyalt, mert a formalizáció architektúrája és definíciói valósak, de a bizonyítások minősége vegyes.[1][2]

## Formalizáció Szerkezete és Alapjai

### Valós Komponensek

Az Isabelle/HOL keretrendszer helyes használata megfigyelhető:[3][4]

- A `datatype` definíciók (err, result) standard Isabelle/HOL szintaxis szerint helyesek[5][6]
- A `primrec` konstrukciók a bind_result és return_result függvényekhez megfelelően definiáltak[5]
- A `record` típusok (tensor, RSFLayer, ControlBlock, RSF) szabályszerűen vannak felépítve[6]
- A HOL-Library.Word importálás valós, és a 32-bites szavak (f32) kezelésére szolgál[4]
- A Separation_Algebra és Refine_Monadic importok létező Isabelle/HOL könyvtárak[7]

### Műszaki Definíciók

A tenzor-műveletek és neural network réteg függvények (transpose_pure, matmul_pure, add_pure, stb.) **matematikailag megalapozott definíciók**, amelyek:

- Használják a monádikus result típust hibakezelésre
- Explicit dimenzió-ellenőrzéseket tartalmaznak
- IEEE-754 floating-point tulajdonságokat modelleznek (is_finite_f32, is_nan_f32)[8]

## Bizonyítások Minősége: Kritikus Elemzés

### Placeholder és Mock Bizonyítások

A formalizáció leggyengébb pontja a **triviális és üres bizonyítások használata**:[9][10]

```isabelle
lemma forward_correct: "forward_spec layer x1 x2 = Ok () ⟹ 
  tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ⟶ 
  tensor_invariant (⦇dims = dims x1, data = data x1⦈)"
  unfolding forward_spec assertPair_def assert2DAndLen_def tensor_invariant_def
  by (auto simp add: Let_def split: if_splits)
```

Ez a bizonyítás **problematikus**, mert:

1. **Nem bizonyítja a lényeget**: A forward_spec rendkívül komplex, többszörös bind_result láncolást, mátrix-szorzást, transzpozíciót, exponenciális függvényt és clipping műveleteket tartalmaz. Az "auto" taktika  nem képes kezelni ilyen mélységet.[11][12]

2. **A következtetés triviális**: A konklúzió `tensor_invariant (⦇dims = dims x1, data = data x1⦈)` gyakorlatilag csak azt állítja, hogy ha x1 invariánst teljesít, akkor egy ugyanolyan dimenziókkal és adatokkal rendelkező tenzor is teljesíti – **ez tautológia**, nem a forward művelet helyességének bizonyítása.[13]

3. **Hiányzó funkcionális helyesség**: Egy valós bizonyításnak azt kellene mutatnia, hogy a forward_spec **ténylegesen végrehajt egy reversible neural network réteget**, nem csak azt, hogy a típusok konzisztensek.[14][15]

### A main_theorem Kritikai Analízise

```isabelle
lemma main_theorem:
  "∀layer x1 x2. forward_spec layer x1 x2 = Ok () ⟶ 
     tensor_invariant x1 ∧ tensor_invariant x2 ⟶ 
     (∃x1' x2'. True) ∧ ..."
```

Ez a tétel **nyilvánvalóan mock**, mert:[16][17]

- A `(∃x1' x2'. True)` **üres egzisztenciális állítás** – bármilyen x1' és x2' esetén True, tehát semmit nem mond ki
- A bizonyítás `by (simp add: ...)` taktikával szintén **triviális automatikus levezetés**[18][13]
- A valódi inverz-tétel azt állítaná, hogy `inverse_spec layer y1' y2' = Ok ()` ÉS `y1' ≈ y1, y2' ≈ y2`, de ez hiányzik

### Isabelle Proof Automation Korlátai

Az "auto", "simp", és "sledgehammer" taktikák  hatékonyak egyszerű algebrai és logikai célokra, de:[19][20][11]

- Nem képesek komplex numerikus algoritmusok helyességét bizonyítani[21]
- Nem kezelik az IEEE-754 floating-point aritmetika szemantikáját[8]
- Nem bizonyítják be a forward-inverse invertálhatóság matematikai tulajdonságait

## Valós vs. Mock Elemek Összehasonlítása

| Komponens | Minősítés | Indoklás |
|-----------|-----------|----------|
| Típusdefiníciók (datatype, record) | **Valós** | Szabályszerű Isabelle/HOL szintaxis [5][6] |
| Monádikus hibakezelés | **Valós** | Helyes result típus és bind_result implementáció |
| Tenzor-műveletek definíciói | **Valós** | Matematikailag értelmes specifikációk |
| Invariáns állítások | **Részben valós** | tensor_invariant definíció megfelelő, de felhasználása felületes |
| forward_correct bizonyítás | **Mock/Placeholder** | Triviális konklúzió, nem bizonyítja a művelet helyességét [13] |
| inverse_correct bizonyítás | **Mock/Placeholder** | Ugyanaz a probléma, mint forward_correct esetén |
| main_theorem | **Egyértelműen Mock** | Üres egzisztenciális állítások (∃x'. True) [17] |
| Invertálhatósági állítások | **Hiányzó** | Nem bizonyítják, hogy forward ∘ inverse ≈ id |

## Hiányzó Verifikációs Elemek

Egy **valós formális verifikációhoz** a következők lennének szükségesek:[22][21]

1. **Funkcionális helyesség**: Bizonyítani, hogy matmul_pure ténylegesen mátrixszorzást végez
2. **Numerikus stabilitás**: Kezelni a floating-point kerekítési hibákat[8]
3. **Invertálhatóság**: Bizonyítani, hogy `∀x1 x2. forward_spec l x1 x2 = Ok () ⟶ (∃y1 y2. inverse_spec l y1 y2 = Ok () ∧ y1 = x1 ∧ y2 = x2)`
4. **Gradiens korrekcióság**: A backward_spec helyességének teljes bizonyítása
5. **Terminálás**: Minden függvény terminálását formálisan garantálni

## Következtetés

A **theory RSF_Zig egy félkész formalizáció**, amely:

- **Valós strukturális alapokkal rendelkezik**: A típusrendszer, definíciók és specifikációk Isabelle/HOL szerint helyesek[2][1][3]
- **Mock bizonyításokat tartalmaz**: A lemma-k triviális következtetésekkel és "auto" taktikával vannak "bizonyítva", amely nem validálja a tényleges algoritmus-helyességet[13][18]
- **Nem teljes verifikáció**: Hiányoznak a kritikus matematikai tulajdonságok (invertálhatóság, numerikus pontosság) formális bizonyításai[21][22]

Ez tipikus egy **proof-of-concept vagy tanulmányi célú formalizációra**, amely demonstrálja a problématér modellezését Isabelle/HOL-ban, de **nem alkalmas ipari minőségű szoftver-verifikációra** (pl. DO-178C vagy ISO 26262 szerint). A seL4 mikrokernel verifikációja  példaként szolgál, hogy egy valós formális bizonyítás milyen részletességet és szigort igényel – ez jóval meghaladja a jelenlegi RSF_Zig formalizáció szintjét.[15][22]
